channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Gurugram YouTuber Thrashed, Paraded and Booked After Viral Video of Feeding Chicken Momos to Cow
item.description: A 28-year-old YouTuber’s paid stunt of feeding chicken momos to a cow sparked outrage, mob assault and a police case in Gurugram.

item.title: Delhi’s ₹5,000 Smog Buster: CM Bans Open Burning & Coal Tandoors as AQI Chokes Capital
item.description: Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta has imposed a complete ban on open burning and coal/firewood use in tandoors, with ₹5,000 fines, to combat rising air pollution in the capital.

item.title: IndiGo Faces Backlash Over 4,600 Cancellations Stranding Lakhs; Chairman Apologises, DGCA Orders Cuts
item.description: IndiGo's widespread December flight cancellations, triggered by new safety rules, prompted a chairman's apology, external probes, and strict DGCA penalties as operations stabilise.

item.title: Polyester Shawls Allegedly Sold As Silk In ₹54 Crore Scam In Tirupati Temple For Over A Decade
item.description: Vigilance probe reveals a contractor allegedly supplied 15,000 polyester dupattas as pure silk to Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanams.

item.title: India Clinches Junior Hockey World Cup Bronze; Strikes Four Late Goals in the Final Quarter to Beat Argentina 4-2 in Chennai
item.description: Trailing 0-2 against Argentina, India's juniors unleashed four goals in the final quarter to secure bronze at the FIH Men's Junior World Cup 2025 in Chennai.

item.title: UNESCO Inscribes Deepavali on Heritage List: India’s 16th Milestone, PM Modi Hails ‘Soul of Civilisation’ Triumph
item.description: UNESCO has inscribed Deepavali, India's vibrant Festival of Lights, as its 16th intangible cultural heritage, celebrating its message of harmony and righteousness worldwide.

item.title: Kerala’s First Gen Z Post Office Opens at Kottayam’s CMS College, Redefining Service as a Green Community Hub
item.description: India Post launched Kerala's first Gen Z Post Office extension counter at CMS College, Kottayam.

item.title: Rajasthan Farmers Allegedly Storm Hanumangarh Ethanol Plant after Year-long Protest; MLA injured as Clashes Erupt with Police
item.description: Hundreds of Rajasthan farmers, protesting for 15 months over water fears, clashed violently with police at a Tibbi ethanol site, torching vehicles and injuring a Congress MLA amid internet blackouts and heavy deployments.

item.title: Husband in Parents’ Total Grip”: SC Orders First-Floor Escape for Pregnant Wife & Daughter to Save Marriage
item.description: In a bid to end in-law interference, the Supreme Court directs a Chhattisgarh couple to live on the first floor with their child, staying all legal battles for reconciliation.

item.title: Fireworks Banned at Nightclubs, Hotels, and Tourist Establishments in North Goa After Fatal Fire Kills 25
item.description: North Goa administration banned all indoor fireworks in tourist establishments after nightclub fire kills 25.
